sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: Pradosia decipiens is an Amazonian tree described to about 20 m. Its alternate leaves are about 8–19 × 4–8 cm. It grows in lowland forest near Manaus and in Colombia, on non-flooded or occasionally flooded sandy soils.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Small greenish flowers grow in groups along the branches. The smooth, yellow, ellipsoid drupes are about 3–3.5 cm long.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish a food use for this species.
